activity.role: Army officer and July 20 resistance conspirator
activity.notes: Representative year 1944 marks Stauffenberg's central role in the military resistance conspiracy and his execution of the July 20 assassination attempt against Adolf Hitler. The Activity is attached to the existing higher-order Germany polity, consistent with ATLAS treatment of the Nazi regime period.
